info.name: Lowtides: AI spend governor
info.description:
One budget and a STOP button between AI agents and money.

Run folders 1-5 in order with the Collection Runner against the public demo (https://lowtides.ai, PayPal sandbox, simulated models, no password) or your own copy. Each run makes its own agent.

1. Setup: create an agent, add a merchant, write the rules in plain English.
2. Agent: the agent checks its budget, makes a model call, and asks before buying. Tests assert each decision.
3. Dashboard: a person approves, denies and KILLs.
4. Webhooks: send events to a Zapier Catch Hook.
5. Consent Shopping: stores, signed Store Policy, Match Finder, Handshake (green, yellow, red), proof pack, trust score, merchant KPIs, shopper preferences, Ask Lowtides.
6. STOP ALL (optional; stops every agent, so every Pass is revoked).

OpenAPI: {{baseUrl}}/openapi.json. Docs: https://github.com/seniorhelper/lowtides

item.name: Ask to buy: small, known merchant -> approved and paid

request.description: Under the $25 line and from a known merchant, so the rules approve it and Lowtides pays through PayPal Payouts.

body.raw:
{
  "amount": 12.0,
  "merchant": "Acme Data",
  "item": "1,000 lead enrichment credits",
  "category": "data",
  "reason": "Needed to finish tonight's lead list"
}

item.name: 5. Consent Shopping (stores, Handshake, proof)
item.description: Two-sided checks: the shopper's Pass against the store's signed Store Policy, with GuardPooch checking the store. Run in order, against the public demo (where the shopper Scout exists; on a private copy the colours depend on which agent you use). Demo stores are fictional; money moves only in the PayPal sandbox, or is a labelled simulation.

item.name: Ask Lowtides: it proposes a STOP ALL, you confirm

header.description: Dashboard password. Leave empty for the public demo.

request.description: The guide never changes anything by itself. It returns a proposed action and a person confirms it. `source` says whether Claude or the scripted guide answered. This example proposes STOP ALL, so confirming it revokes every Pass, like Stop all.

exec: // Same thing in dotted form, for the repo test runner (tests/test_openapi.py): pm.collectionVariables.set("actionId", j.actions.0.id);
